Frequently Asked Questions

What is the $ELON presale?

The presale is an exclusive early opportunity to buy $ELON before it becomes available for public trading. Early investors get access to the lowest prices and special benefits before the official launch.

How do I participate in the presale?

You can participate by connecting your wallet (or depositing funds into your exchange account), selecting the amount of $ELON you want to buy, and confirming your transaction. Your purchase will be secured, and your tokens will be delivered at launch.

When will my presale tokens be available?

All presale tokens will be securely held until the official launch date. On the launch date, your tokens will be automatically transferred to your trading wallet on our exchange.

Why are my tokens locked until launch?

To protect investors and prevent price manipulation, all presale tokens are locked until launch. This ensures a fair and stable market when trading begins.

Where will my tokens be sent after launch?

Once $ELON launches, your tokens will be automatically deposited into your trading wallet on our exchange. You will be able to trade, stake, or withdraw them as you choose.

Is my investment safe?

Yes! All presale transactions are secured by a smart contract, ensuring funds are safely held and automatically distributed at launch. We are fully committed to transparency, security, and fairness.

Can I withdraw my funds before launch?

No, presale funds are locked until launch to ensure fair distribution and a stable price. However, once your tokens are delivered at launch, you can trade, stake, or hold them as you choose.

Are there any bonuses for presale investors?

Yes! As a presale investor, you get a discounted token price (lower than the public launch price), exclusive early access to trading on launch day, and special staking rewards (earn extra tokens by holding).

Can I stake my tokens before launch?

Yes! We offer a pre-staking option for presale buyers. By staking your presale tokens early, you can earn bonus rewards before they even unlock.

Will there be a vesting schedule for presale tokens?

No, all presale tokens unlock fully at launch.

What makes $ELON different from other cryptocurrencies?

$ELON is exclusively available on our exchange, meaning all trading, staking, and rewards happen within our platform. This exclusivity increases demand and strengthens price stability.

Will $ELON be listed on other exchanges?

At this time, $ELON will only be available on our exchange. This allows us to control liquidity, prevent manipulation, and provide the best benefits for our investors.

How do I claim my tokens after launch?

You don’t have to do anything! Your tokens will be automatically credited to your trading wallet as soon as the launch happens. You can log into your account and start trading immediately.

What happens if I miss the presale?

If you miss the presale, you can still buy $ELON when trading opens. However, presale buyers get a lower price and exclusive benefits, so it’s best to join early.

How can I stay updated on the presale and launch?

Join our email list to get real-time updates, reminders, and exclusive announcements.

How ElonX uses cookies and other similar technology on this website

This policy is effective as of April 1, 2025. Please note that this privacy statement will be updated from time to time.

What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website, downloaded to your computer or mobile device when you visit a site, and allow the site to recognize your device. Cookies store information about the user’s visit, which may include content viewed, language preference, time and duration of each visit, and advertisements accessed. Cookies managed by ElonX are called “first-party cookies,” whereas cookies from third parties are called “third-party cookies.”

Why do we use cookies and similar technologies?

Cookies are a useful mechanism that serve many purposes, such as letting you navigate between pages efficiently, remembering your preferences, and generally improving your user experience. They can also help ensure that the advertisements you see online are more relevant to you and your interests and enable us to identify your preferences. There are different sets of cookies, which we will explain further in this document.

Does ElonX use cookies for marketing and analytics?

Yes, we may use information collected from our cookies to analyze user behavior and serve content and offers based on your profile, and for other purposes described below, to the extent legally permissible in certain jurisdictions.

In some cases, we may associate cookie information (including information from cookies placed via our advertisements on third-party sites) with an identifiable individual.

Do you use any cookies from third-party companies?

Some cookies, web beacons, and other tracking and storage technologies that we use are from third-party companies (third-party cookies) to provide us with web analytics and intelligence about our sites, which may also be used to provide measurement services and target ads.

What if I don’t want cookies or similar tracking technologies?

You can adjust your preferences regarding cookies through our cookie setting center. If you want to remove existing cookies from your device, you can do so using your browser options.

If you want to block future cookies from being placed on your device, you can modify the settings at our cookie setting center. However, please consider that deleting and blocking cookies may impact your user experience.

More Information

We may place cookies and other similar technologies on your device, including your mobile device, in accordance with your preferences set in our cookie setting center. Depending on your settings in our cookie consent manager on your mobile device, the following information may be collected through cookies or similar technology: your unique device identifier, mobile device IP address, information about your device’s operating system, mobile carrier, and location information (to the extent permissible under applicable law).

Every time you visit the ElonX website, you will be prompted to accept or reject cookies, and you can also tailor your selection.

If you are still looking for more information, you can contact us through one of our preferred contact methods: Email: support@elonx.co
